entities.summary: Janissary, a notable figure in the history of Türkiye, associated with Ottoman Decline and Reform (1789–1839). Preceded by Early Reforms and Janissary Abolition and Second Siege of Vienna fails — beginning of Ottoman territorial retreat. Their legacy influenced 'Auspicious Incident' — Mahmud II destroys the Janissary Corps and Gülhane Decree launches the Tanzimat modernization program.
